ceiling-as-json-float.json.why: The ceiling is written as a float dollar amount; money is integer nano-dollars and never a JSON float (6.4).

ceiling-charge-below-ceiling.json.why: A ceiling charge bills the full ceiling (7.5); charging less would let a charge fall below true cost (B1).

ceiling-charge-on-unbounded-attempt.json.why: A ceiling charge needs a ceiling to charge; an unbounded attempt has none, so charging it would settle at zero.

ceiling-charge-without-unknown.json.why: A ceiling charge settles only an attempt whose path went through unknown (7.5); this one claims a timeout but its transitions go straight from dispatched to settled.

ceiling-null-without-reason.json.why: A null ceiling must carry ceiling_unavailable_reason, so an unbounded attempt is never mistaken for a missing value.

cost-as-usd-decimal-string.json.why: Settled cost is integer nano-dollars, not a USD decimal string (6.4).

free-text-in-settlement.json.why: A settlement is closed: no field can carry prompt or response text (C2).

free-text-in-transition-record.json.why: A transition record is closed: no field can carry prompt or response text (C2).

free-text-note-at-root.json.why: The attempt record is closed and holds no free text, so a note field could carry prompt content (C2).

missing-price-book-version.json.why: Every attempt records the price-book version effective when its reservation committed, which prices it (P1).

negative-ceiling.json.why: A negative ceiling would add headroom instead of holding it, breaking the B1 admission check.

overrun-not-flagged.json.why: Cost above the ceiling is an invariant breach that must be flagged and paged (7.6), never hidden.

released-without-release-reason.json.why: Releasing a ceiling is only allowed when the upstream connection failed before any byte was sent, and the record must say so (7.5).

reserved-with-transitions.json.why: A reserved attempt has taken no transitions; one that was dispatched cannot still claim to be reserved.

settled-without-settlement.json.why: A settled attempt must say how its cost was established, or the cost added to spent has no basis (7.5, 7.6).

settlement-on-unknown-attempt.json.why: An unknown attempt keeps its ceiling reserved; a settlement belongs only to a settled attempt, or the cost would be counted while the ceiling is still held.

unbounded-ceiling-given-as-zero.json.why: An unbounded attempt's ceiling is unavailable, which is null with a reason, never zero.
